beats.text: Russia and Ukraine just agreed what could be the war's biggest prisoner swap. So, is peace close?
Let's not get ahead of ourselves. US envoys are flying to Moscow, then Dublin, just to keep talks going.

beats.speaker: everyman
beats.text: So it's basically a handshake on paper while the missiles keep flying?
beats.name: Leo Vance

beats.text: Territory is still unresolved, and Moscow wants all of the Donbas. Kyiv says it won't give up land.
So, is peace close? One swap, no deal on territory, and a lot of flights. Let's call it... a very cautious maybe.

plan.cta: The full breakdown is on our YouTube channel; link in bio.
plan.caption: Russia and Ukraine agreed what could be the war's biggest prisoner swap, a real lifeline for families. But territory is still unresolved. Is peace close? Let's call it a very cautious maybe. Watch the full breakdown on our YouTube channel. Link in bio.
